Earnings binary within 24 hours [SA-FIN-3] with wide outcome distribution: second analyst downgrade citing valuation pressure and an active Japan regulatory probe sit against intact bullish MACD, bullish stochastic, and 94th intra-sector relative positioning. Zero options flow across financials [SA-FIN-ANOM-2] eliminates any market-implied directional bias going in. Preserved as a post-print re-examination flag; pre-print directional commitment is not supported by current signal density.
